blocks.title: Internal energy
blocks.text: Kisi madde ki molecular energies ki sab shakalon (kinetic aur potential) ka majmooa us ki internal energy kehlata hai. Thermodynamics ke mutaale mein aam taur par ideal gas ko working substance mana jata hai; ideal gas ke molecules mehz nuqtai masses hain jo ek doosre par koi force nahi lagate, to ideal gas system ki internal energy aam taur par us ke molecules ki translational KE hai. Chunke system ka temperature us ke molecules ki ausat KE ke taur par bayan hota hai, ideal gas ke liye internal energy us ke temperature ke seedhe tanasub mein hai.

Gases ke kinetic theory ke mutabiq gas ke molecules ki ausat kinetic energy (1/2) m v^2 ki ausat = (3/2) k_B T se milti hai, jahan k_B Boltzmann constant hai. Is liye kisi cheez ke temperature ka barhna us ke zarron ki internal kinetic energy ke izafe ki akkasi karta hai. Internal energy ka yeh izafa heat energy jazb hone se ho sakta hai, jo zarron ki ausat kinetic energy barhati aur yun cheez ka temperature barhati hai.

Diatomic gas ke molecule mein translational aur rotational dono energy hoti hai; us mein apne atoms ke darmiyan spring jaise bond se juri vibrational energy bhi hai (Do You Know). Mukhtalif amal internal energy aur temperature mein tabdeeli la sakte hain, jaise garam karna (heat dena), adiabatic compression ya expansion (koi heat ka tabadla nahi), ya phase ki tabdeeliyan, jahan heat energy temperature badle baghair madde ki halat badalti hai (Tidbits). Internal energy ek state function hai: yeh raste par nahi balke system ki ibtidai aur aakhri halaton par munhasir hai; yun internal energy gravitational PE jaisi hai, aur potential energy ki tarah internal energy ki tabdeeli aham hai, us ki mutlaq qeemat nahi (For Your Information).

blocks.prompt: Internal energy se kya murad hai, aur yeh ideal gas ke temperature se kaise juri hai (short question 6.2; MCQ 6.7)?
blocks.explanation: Internal energy kisi madde ke sab molecules ki kul kinetic aur potential energy hai. Ideal gas ke liye molecular potential energy nahi, to U kul translational kinetic energy hai, jo ausatan fi molecule (3/2) k_B T hai; is liye U mutlaq temperature ke seedhe tanasub mein hai, aur temperature ka barhna internal energy ka barhna hai.

items: Internal energy = sab molecular KE + PE; ideal gas ke liye sirf translational KE, ausat (1/2) m v^2 = (3/2) k_B T, to U T ke tanasub mein. State function: sirf delta U aham. Garam karna, adiabatic tabdeeliyan aur phase ki tabdeeliyan ise badalti hain.
